# Retrieve Metrics
Source: https://resend.com/docs/api-reference/emails/get-metrics

GET /emails/metrics
Retrieve account-level email metrics.

> [!NOTE]
>
> Metrics are retained according to your plan's data retention window.
> Requesting a `start_date` older than your retention window returns data
> clamped to the oldest date your plan retains. This doesn't apply when
> `broadcast_id` is set.

> [!NOTE]
>
> Responses are cached for up to 15 minutes, so a request for the same range may
> return slightly stale data within that window.

All parameters are optional. With none, the response covers the last 7 days
(today plus the 6 previous days), includes every metric, and returns only
`totals`.

## Query Parameters

List-type query parameters below accept a comma-separated value, the
parameter repeated (`domain_id=a&domain_id=b`), or a mix of
both.

**start\_date** `string`

The start of the date range, as an ISO 8601 date (`2026-07-01`) or datetime
(`2026-07-01T00:00:00Z`). Must be on or before `end_date`, and can equal it to
query a single day. Defaults to 6 days before `end_date`.

**end\_date** `string`

The end of the date range, as an ISO 8601 date or datetime. Values in the
future are clamped to the current time. Defaults to now.

**timezone** `string` (default: UTC)

The IANA timezone (e.g. `America/New_York`) used to bucket periods when
`period` is in `dimensions`.

**granularity** `hourly | daily | weekly | monthly` (default: daily)

The bucket size used when `period` is in `dimensions`. Accepted but has no
effect otherwise. The date range can't produce more than 10,000 periods at the
chosen granularity. This limit only applies when `period` is in `dimensions`.

**metrics** `string[]`

List of metrics to include in the response. Omit for all. See
[Metrics](#metrics).

**dimensions** `string[]` (default: \[])

List of dimensions to break the response down by. Combine
any of `period`, `domain`, `email`, or `broadcast` to group the data by
more than one at once, except `email` cannot be combined with `broadcast`.
Omit for a single `totals` row for the whole range, with no `data`.

Possible values:

* `period`: groups the data by `granularity` period, in chronological order.
* `domain`: groups the data by sending domain.
* `email`: groups the data by email. Cannot be combined with `broadcast`.
* `broadcast`: groups the data by broadcast. Cannot be combined with `email`.

**domain\_id** `string[]`

List of sending domain IDs to restrict the response to, up to 100.

**email\_id** `string[]`

List of email IDs to restrict the response to, up to 100. Cannot be combined
with the `broadcast` dimension or `broadcast_id`.

**broadcast\_id** `string[]`

List of broadcast IDs to restrict the response to, up to 100. Cannot be
combined with the `email` dimension or `email_id`.

> [!TIP]
>
> For a 24-hour breakdown of one day, set `start_date` and `end_date` to the
> same date, with `granularity=hourly` and `period` in `dimensions`.

## Metrics

| Metric | Description |
| - | - |
| `received` | Emails Resend accepted for processing. |
| `sent` | Emails sent to the recipient's mail server. |
| `delivered` | Emails the recipient's mail server accepted. |
| `delivery_delayed` | Delivery postponed by a temporary issue. Not final. |
| `failed` | Emails that never reached a mail server. |
| `suppressed` | Skipped because the recipient is [suppressed](/docs/dashboard/emails/email-suppressions). |
| `bounced` | All [bounces](/docs/dashboard/emails/email-bounces), summing the three below. |
| `bounced_transient` | Soft bounce. Temporary, so a later send can succeed. |
| `bounced_permanent` | Hard bounce. Permanent, and the address is suppressed. |
| `bounced_undetermined` | Bounce with no classifiable reason. |
| `opened` | Open events, including repeats. |
| `unique_opened` | Emails opened at least once. |
| `clicked` | Link click events, including repeats. |
| `unique_clicked` | Emails clicked at least once. |
| `complained` | Delivered emails marked as spam. |
| `unsubscribed` | Recipients who unsubscribed. |
| `delivery_rate` | `delivered` / `sent` |
| `open_rate` | `unique_opened` / `delivered` |
| `click_rate` | `unique_clicked` / `delivered` |
| `bounce_rate` | `bounced` / `sent` |
| `complaint_rate` | `complained` / `delivered` |
| `unsubscribe_rate` | `unsubscribed` / `delivered` |

> [!NOTE]
>
> Open and click metrics require [open and click
> tracking](/docs/dashboard/domains/tracking) on the sending domain.

```ts Node.js theme={"theme":{"light":"github-light","dark":"vesper"}}
import { Resend } from 'resend';

const resend = new Resend('re_xxxxxxxxx');

  endDate: '2026-07-08',
  metrics: ['sent', 'delivered', 'open_rate'],
  dimensions: ['period', 'broadcast'],
  broadcastId: ['5a5a3b1e-3b1a-4b1a-8b1a-3b1a4b1a8b1a'],
});
```

```go Go theme={"theme":{"light":"github-light","dark":"vesper"}}
package main

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"

	"github.com/resend/resend-go/v4"
)

func main() {
  ctx := context.TODO()
  client := resend.NewClient("re_xxxxxxxxx")

  startDate := "2026-07-01"
  endDate := "2026-07-08"

  metrics, err := client.Emails.MetricsWithOptions(ctx, &resend.MetricsOptions{
    StartDate: &startDate,
    EndDate:   &endDate,
    Metrics: []resend.MetricName{
      resend.MetricSent,
      resend.MetricDelivered,
      resend.MetricOpenRate,
    },
    Dimensions: []resend.MetricsDimension{
      resend.MetricsDimensionPeriod,
      resend.MetricsDimensionBroadcast,
    },
    BroadcastId: []string{"5a5a3b1e-3b1a-4b1a-8b1a-3b1a4b1a8b1a"},
  })

  if err != nil {
    panic(err)
  }
  fmt.Println(metrics.Totals)
}
```

# List Attachments
Source: https://resend.com/docs/api-reference/emails/list-email-attachments

GET /emails/:email_id/attachments
Retrieve a list of attachments from a sent email.

## Query Parameters

Note that the `limit` parameter is *optional*. If
you do not provide a `limit`, all attachments will be returned
in a single response.

**limit** `number`

Number of attachments to retrieve.
<ul><li>Maximum value: `100`</li>
<li>Minimum value: `1`</li></ul>

**after** `string`

The ID *after* which we'll retrieve more attachments (for pagination).
This ID will *not* be included in the returned list. Cannot be
used with the
`before` parameter.
**before** `string`

The ID *before* which we'll retrieve more attachments (for
pagination). This ID will *not* be included in the returned list.
Cannot be used with the `after` parameter.

> [!NOTE]
>
> You can only use either `after` or `before`
> parameter, not both. See our
> [pagination guide](/docs/api-reference/pagination) for more
> information.

## Path Parameters

**email\_id** `string` *required*

The Email ID.

# List Sent Emails
Source: https://resend.com/docs/api-reference/emails/list-emails

GET /emails
Retrieve a list of emails sent by your team.

You can list all emails sent by your team. The list returns references to individual emails. If needed, you can use the `id` of an email to retrieve the email HTML to plain text using the [Retrieve Email](/docs/api-reference/emails/retrieve-email) endpoint or the [Retrieve Attachments](/docs/api-reference/emails/list-email-attachments) endpoint to get an email's attachments.

> [!NOTE]
>
> This endpoint only returns emails sent by your team. If you need to list
> emails received by your domain, use the [List Received
> Emails](/docs/api-reference/emails/list-received-emails) endpoint.

## Query Parameters

**limit** `number`

Number of emails to retrieve.
<ul><li>Default value: `20`</li>
<li>Maximum value: `100`</li>
<li>Minimum value: `1`</li></ul>

**after** `string`

The ID *after* which we'll retrieve more emails (for pagination).
This ID will *not* be included in the returned list. Cannot be
used with the
`before` parameter.
**before** `string`

The ID *before* which we'll retrieve more emails (for
pagination). This ID will *not* be included in the returned list.
Cannot be used with the `after` parameter.

> [!NOTE]
>
> You can only use either `after` or `before`
> parameter, not both. See our
> [pagination guide](/docs/api-reference/pagination) for more
> information.

```ts Node.js theme={"theme":{"light":"github-light","dark":"vesper"}}
import { Resend } from 'resend';
```

```go Go theme={"theme":{"light":"github-light","dark":"vesper"}}
package main

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/resend/resend-go/v4"
)

func main() {
	ctx := context.TODO()
	client := resend.NewClient("re_xxxxxxxxx")

	paginatedResp, err := client.Emails.ListWithOptions(ctx, nil)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}

	if paginatedResp.HasMore {
		opts := &resend.ListOptions{
			After: &paginatedResp.Data[len(paginatedResp.Data)-1].Id,
		}
		client.Emails.ListWithOptions(ctx, opts)
	}
}
```

```rust Rust theme={"theme":{"light":"github-light","dark":"vesper"}}
  Ok(())
}
```

# List Received Emails
Source: https://resend.com/docs/api-reference/emails/list-received-emails

GET /emails/receiving
Retrieve a list of received emails for the authenticated user.

You can list all emails received by your team. The list returns references to individual emails. If needed, you can use the `id` of an email to retrieve the email HTML to plain text using the [Retrieve Received Email](/docs/api-reference/emails/retrieve-received-email) endpoint or the [Retrieve Received Attachment](/docs/api-reference/emails/retrieve-received-email-attachment) endpoint to get an email's attachments.

> [!NOTE]
>
> This endpoint only returns emails received by your team. If you need to list
> emails sent by your team, use the [List Sent
> Emails](/docs/api-reference/emails/list-emails) endpoint.

## Query Parameters

Note that the `limit` parameter is *optional*. If
you do not provide a `limit`, all emails will be returned
in a single response.

**limit** `number`

Number of emails to retrieve.
<ul><li>Maximum value: `100`</li>
<li>Minimum value: `1`</li></ul>

**after** `string`

The ID *after* which we'll retrieve more emails (for pagination).
This ID will *not* be included in the returned list. Cannot be
used with the
`before` parameter.
**before** `string`

The ID *before* which we'll retrieve more emails (for
pagination). This ID will *not* be included in the returned list.
Cannot be used with the `after` parameter.

> [!NOTE]
>
> You can only use either `after` or `before`
> parameter, not both. See our
> [pagination guide](/docs/api-reference/pagination) for more
> information.

# Retrieve Received Email
Source: https://resend.com/docs/api-reference/emails/retrieve-received-email

GET /emails/receiving/:email_id
Retrieve a single received email.

## Path Parameters

**id** `string` *required*

The ID for the received email.

## Query Parameters

**html\_format** `'data_uri' | 'cid'`

Controls how inline images are returned inside `html`. The response echoes
the form actually served as `html_format` on the body.

By default (or when set to `data_uri`), inline images appear in `html` as base64 `data:` URIs. Set `html_format=cid` to keep the original `<img src="cid:..." />` references instead. Each `cid:` matches the `content_id` of an attachment, so you can correlate inline images with entries in the `attachments` array and fetch them via the attachment download endpoint.

Emails whose inlined HTML would exceed 100 MB, typically long reply chains that quote the same inline image hundreds of times, are always stored and returned with `cid:` references. For those emails the response reports `html_format: "cid"` regardless of the requested format, so check the `html_format` field on the body rather than assuming the format you asked for.

## Response Fields

**html\_format** `'data_uri' | 'cid'`

How inline images are referenced in `html`. Usually matches the requested
format, but is `cid` when the email is too large to inline (see the query
parameter above).

**received\_for** `array`

The recipient addresses the email was forwarded for, taken from the `for`
clause of the message's `Received` headers.

**authentication** `object | null`

The SPF, DKIM, and DMARC results computed when the email was received. These
come from the receiving mail server, not from the message headers, so the
sender cannot forge them. `null` for emails received before this field was
introduced.

**properties**

**spf** `'pass' | 'fail' | 'gray' | 'processing_failed' | 'unknown'`

SPF result. `gray` means the result was `none`, `softfail`, or `neutral`.

**dkim** `'pass' | 'fail' | 'gray' | 'processing_failed' | 'unknown'`

DKIM result. `gray` means the message is not signed, or the signing
domain does not match the `From` domain.

**dmarc** `'pass' | 'fail' | 'gray' | 'processing_failed' | 'unknown'`

DMARC result. `gray` means SPF or DKIM passed but the sending domain has
no DMARC policy or uses `p=none`.

**raw** `object | null`

Raw email content download information. Contains a signed URL to download the original email file including all attachments.

**properties**

**download\_url** `string`

Signed CloudFront URL to download the raw email file.

**expires\_at** `string`

ISO 8601 timestamp indicating when the download URL expires.

```java Java theme={"theme":{"light":"github-light","dark":"vesper"}}
      "2a0c9ce0-3112-4728-976e-47ddcd16a318"
    );
  }
}
```

# Send Batch Emails
Source: https://resend.com/docs/api-reference/emails/send-batch-emails

POST /emails/batch
Trigger up to 100 batch emails at once.

Instead of sending one email per HTTP request, Resend provides a batching endpoint that permits you to send up to 100 emails in a single API call.

## Body Parameters

**from** `string` *required*

Sender email address.

To include a friendly name, pass the sender as `Name <email@example.com>`, for example `Acme <onboarding@example.dev>`.

**to** `string | string[]` *required*

Recipient email address. For multiple addresses, send as an array of strings.
Max 50.

**subject** `string` *required*

Email subject.

**bcc** `string | string[]`

Bcc recipient email address. For multiple addresses, send as an array of
strings.

**cc** `string | string[]`

Cc recipient email address. For multiple addresses, send as an array of
strings.

Schedule email to be sent later. The date should be in natural language (e.g.: `in 1 min`) or ISO 8601 format (e.g:
`2026-08-05T11:52:01.858Z`).

[See examples](/docs/dashboard/emails/schedule-email)

Reply-to email address. For multiple addresses, send as an array of strings.

**html** `string`

The HTML version of the message.

**text** `string`

The plain text version of the message.

> [!NOTE]
>
> If not provided, the HTML will be used to generate a plain text version. You
> can opt out of this behavior by setting value to an empty string.

**react** `React.ReactNode`

The React component used to write the message. *Only available in the Node.js
SDK.*

**headers** `object`

Custom headers to add to the email.

The topic ID to receive the email.

* If the recipient is a contact and has opted-in to the topic, the email is sent.
* If the recipient is a contact and has opted-out of the topic, the email is not sent and will be marked as failed.
* If the recipient is not a contact, the email is sent if the topic default subscription value is set to `opt-in`.

> [!NOTE]
>
> Each email address (to, cc, bcc) is checked and handled separately.

**tags** `array`

Custom data passed in key/value pairs.

[See examples](/docs/dashboard/emails/tags).

**properties**

**name** `string` *required*

The name of the email tag.

It can only contain ASCII letters (a–z, A–Z), numbers (0–9), underscores (\_), or dashes (-).

It can contain no more than 256 characters.

**value** `string` *required*

The value of the email tag.

It can only contain ASCII letters (a–z, A–Z), numbers (0–9), underscores (\_), or dashes (-).

It can contain no more than 256 characters.

**template** `object`

To send using a template, provide a `template` object with:

* `id`: the id *or* the alias of the published template
* `variables`: an object with a key for each variable (if applicable)

> [!NOTE]
>
> If a `template` is provided, you cannot send `html`, `text`, or `react` in the payload, otherwise the API will return a validation error.
>
> When sending a template, the payload for `from`, `subject`, and `reply_to` take precedence over the template's defaults for these fields. If the template does not provide a default value for these fields, you must provide them in the payload.

**id** `string` *required*

The id of the published email template. Required if `template` is provided. Only published templates can be used when sending emails.

**variables** `object`

Template variables object with key/value pairs.

```ts theme={"theme":{"light":"github-light","dark":"vesper"}}
variables: {
	CTA: 'Sign up now',
	CTA_LINK: 'https://example.com/signup'
}
```

When sending the template, the HTML will be parsed. If all the variables used in the template were provided, the email will be sent. If not, the call will throw a validation error.

See the [errors reference](/docs/api-reference/errors) for more details or [learn more about templates](/docs/dashboard/templates/introduction).

**properties**

**key** `string` *required*

The key of the variable.

May only contain ASCII letters (a–z, A–Z), numbers (0–9), and underscores (\_). The following variable names are reserved and cannot be used: `FIRST_NAME`, `LAST_NAME`, `EMAIL`, `UNSUBSCRIBE_URL`.

It can contain no more than 50 characters.

**value** `string | number` *required*

The value of the variable.

Observe these technical limitations:

* `string`: maximum length of 2,000 characters
* `number`: not greater than 2^53 - 1

## Headers

**Idempotency-Key** `string`

Add an idempotency key to prevent duplicated emails.

* Should be **unique per API request**
* Idempotency keys expire after **24 hours**
* Have a maximum length of **256 characters**

[Learn more about idempotency keys →](/docs/dashboard/emails/idempotency-keys)

## Limitations

The `attachments` field is not supported yet.

## Response format

When the request succeeds, each entry in `data` corresponds to the email at the same index in the batch payload (0-based). The first email in your request will be the first entry in `data`, and so on.

```ts Node.js theme={"theme":{"light":"github-light","dark":"vesper"}}
import { Resend } from 'resend';

const resend = new Resend('re_xxxxxxxxx');

const { data, error } = await resend.batch.send([
  {
    from: 'Acme <onboarding@resend.dev>',
    to: ['foo@gmail.com'],
    subject: 'hello world',
    html: '<h1>it works!</h1>',
  },
  {
    from: 'Acme <onboarding@resend.dev>',
    to: ['bar@outlook.com'],
    subject: 'world hello',
    html: '<p>it works!</p>',
  },
]);
```

```php PHP theme={"theme":{"light":"github-light","dark":"vesper"}}

    'from' => 'Acme <onboarding@resend.dev>',

  ],
  [
    'from' => 'Acme <onboarding@resend.dev>',
    'to' => ['bar@outlook.com'],
    'subject' => 'world hello',
    'html' => '<p>it works!</p>',
  ]
]);
```


```go Go theme={"theme":{"light":"github-light","dark":"vesper"}}
package main

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"

	"github.com/resend/resend-go/v4"
)

func main() {

  ctx := context.TODO()

  client := resend.NewClient("re_xxxxxxxxx")

  var batchEmails = []*resend.SendEmailRequest{
    {
      From:    "Acme <onboarding@resend.dev>",
      To:      []string{"foo@gmail.com"},
      Subject: "hello world",
      Html:    "<h1>it works!</h1>",
    },
    {
      From:    "Acme <onboarding@resend.dev>",
      To:      []string{"bar@outlook.com"},
      Subject: "world hello",
      Html:    "<p>it works!</p>",
    },
  }

  sent, err := client.Batch.SendWithContext(ctx, batchEmails)

  if err != nil {
    panic(err)
  }
  fmt.Println(sent.Data)
}
```

```rust Rust theme={"theme":{"light":"github-light","dark":"vesper"}}
use resend_rs::types::CreateEmailBaseOptions;
use resend_rs::{Resend, Result};

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() -> Result<()> {
  let resend = Resend::new("re_xxxxxxxxx");

  let emails = vec![
    CreateEmailBaseOptions::new(
      "Acme <onboarding@resend.dev>",
      vec!["foo@gmail.com"],
      "hello world",
    )
    .with_html("<h1>it works!</h1>"),
    CreateEmailBaseOptions::new(
      "Acme <onboarding@resend.dev>",
      vec!["bar@outlook.com"],
      "world hello",
    )
    .with_html("<p>it works!</p>"),
  ];

  let _emails = resend.batch.send(emails).await?;

  Ok(())
}
```

```java Java theme={"theme":{"light":"github-light","dark":"vesper"}}
        );
```

# Send Email

Start sending emails through the Resend Email API.

## Body Parameters

**from** `string` *required*

`2026-08-05T11:52:01.858Z`).

**properties**

**filename** `string`

**id** `string` *required*

The id of the published email template. Required if `template` is provided. Only published templates can be used when sending emails.

**variables** `object`

Template variables object with key/value pairs.

```ts theme={"theme":{"light":"github-light","dark":"vesper"}}

	CTA: 'Sign up now',
```

# Share Email
Source: https://resend.com/docs/api-reference/emails/share-email

POST /emails/:email_id/share
Create a shareable link to view a sent or received email.

## Path Parameters

The Email ID.

## Body Parameters

How long the link stays valid for, as a duration like `10m`, `2 hours`, or `1
    day`. Defaults to `48h` and cannot exceed 48 hours.

```ts Node.js theme={"theme":{"light":"github-light","dark":"vesper"}}
import { Resend } from 'resend';

const resend = new Resend('re_xxxxxxxxx');

const { data, error } = await resend.emails.share(
  '49a3999c-0ce1-4ea6-ab68-afcd6dc2e794',
  { expiresIn: '2 hours' },
);
```

```php PHP theme={"theme":{"light":"github-light","dark":"vesper"}}
$resend = Resend::client('re_xxxxxxxxx');

$resend->emails->share('49a3999c-0ce1-4ea6-ab68-afcd6dc2e794', [
  'expires_in' => '2 hours'
]);
```

```python Python theme={"theme":{"light":"github-light","dark":"vesper"}}
import resend

resend.api_key = "re_xxxxxxxxx"

share_params: resend.Emails.ShareParams = {
  "expires_in": "2 hours"
}

resend.Emails.share(
  email_id="49a3999c-0ce1-4ea6-ab68-afcd6dc2e794",
  params=share_params
)
```

# Update Email
Source: https://resend.com/docs/api-reference/emails/update-email

PATCH /emails/:email_id
Update a scheduled email.

## Path Parameters

**id** `string` *required*

The Email ID.

## Body Parameters

Schedule email to be sent later. The date should be in ISO 8601 format (e.g:
2026-08-05T11:52:01.858Z).

```ts Node.js theme={"theme":{"light":"github-light","dark":"vesper"}}
import { Resend } from 'resend';

const resend = new Resend('re_xxxxxxxxx');

const oneMinuteFromNow = new Date(Date.now() + 1000 * 60).toISOString();

const { data, error } = await resend.emails.update({
  id: '49a3999c-0ce1-4ea6-ab68-afcd6dc2e794',
  scheduledAt: oneMinuteFromNow,
});
```

```php PHP theme={"theme":{"light":"github-light","dark":"vesper"}}
$resend = Resend::client('re_xxxxxxxxx');

$oneMinuteFromNow = (new DateTime())->modify('+1 minute')->format(DateTime::ISO8601);

$resend->emails->update('49a3999c-0ce1-4ea6-ab68-afcd6dc2e794', [
  'scheduled_at' => $oneMinuteFromNow
]);
```

```python Python theme={"theme":{"light":"github-light","dark":"vesper"}}

from datetime import datetime, timedelta

  "id": "49a3999c-0ce1-4ea6-ab68-afcd6dc2e794",
```


```go Go theme={"theme":{"light":"github-light","dark":"vesper"}}

	"time"

	"github.com/resend/resend-go/v4"

	oneMinuteFromNowIso := oneMinuteFromNow.Format("2006-01-02T15:04:05-0700")

	updateParams := &resend.UpdateEmailRequest{
		Id:          "49a3999c-0ce1-4ea6-ab68-afcd6dc2e794",
```

```rust Rust theme={"theme":{"light":"github-light","dark":"vesper"}}

use resend_rs::types::UpdateEmailOptions;
use resend_rs::{Resend, Result};

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() -> Result<()> {
  let resend = Resend::new("re_xxxxxxxxx");

  let one_minute_from_now = Local::now()
    .checked_add_signed(TimeDelta::minutes(1))
    .unwrap()
    .to_rfc3339();

  let update = UpdateEmailOptions::new()
    .with_scheduled_at(&one_minute_from_now);

  let _email = resend
    .emails
    .update("49a3999c-0ce1-4ea6-ab68-afcd6dc2e794", update)
    .await?;

  Ok(())
}
```

# Errors
Source: https://resend.com/docs/api-reference/errors

Troubleshoot problems with this comprehensive breakdown of all error codes.

## Error schema

Resend uses standard HTTP response codes for success and failure notifications, and errors are further classified by type.

### `invalid_idempotency_key`

* **Status:** 400
* **Message:** Idempotency keys, if present, must have between 1 and 256 characters.
* **Suggested action:** Retry with a valid idempotency key.

### `validation_error`

* **Status:** 400
* **Message:** An error was found with one or more fields in the request.
* **Suggested action:** The message will contain more details about what field and error were found.

### `validation_error`

* **Status:** 400
* **Message:** API key is invalid
* **Suggested action:** Check the key on the [API Keys page](https://resend.com/api-keys) and create a new one if it was deleted. Every endpoint except sending returns this for a key that doesn't exist or was deleted, and every endpoint returns it when the `Authorization` header isn't a valid key.

### `missing_api_key`

* **Status:** 401
* **Message:** Missing API Key
* **Suggested action:** Include the following header in the request: `Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY`.

### `restricted_api_key`

* **Status:** 401
* **Message:** This API key is restricted to only send emails.
* **Suggested action:** Make sure the API key has `Full access` to perform actions other than sending emails.

### `validation_error`

* **Status:** 401
* **Message:** API key is invalid
* **Suggested action:** Check the key on the [API Keys page](https://resend.com/api-keys) and create a new one if it was deleted. The sending endpoints return this for a key that doesn't exist, was deleted, or isn't active.

### `email_above_quota`

* **Status:** 403
* **Message:** You can't retrieve this email's content because it was above quota when received.
* **Suggested action:** [Upgrade your plan](https://resend.com/settings/billing) to increase your quota.

### `invalid_permission`

* **Status:** 403
* **Message:** Access token is missing required scopes.
* **Suggested action:** Request an access token that includes the scopes required by this endpoint.

### `restricted_api_key`

* **Status:** 403
* **Message:** API key is not active
* **Suggested action:** Check the API key on the [API Keys page](https://resend.com/api-keys) and create a new one if needed.

### `suspended_api_key`

* **Status:** 403
* **Message:** This API key is suspended
* **Suggested action:** [Contact support](https://resend.com/contact) if you believe this is a mistake.

### `validation_error`

* **Status:** 403
* **Message:** You can only send testing emails to your own email address (`youremail@domain.com`). To send emails to other recipients, please verify a domain at resend.com/domains, and change the `from` address to an email using this domain.
* **Suggested action:** In [Resend's Domain page](https://resend.com/domains), add and verify a domain for which you have DNS access. This allows you to send emails to addresses beyond your own. [Learn more about resolving this error](/docs/knowledge-base/403-error-resend-dev-domain).

### `validation_error`

* **Status:** 403
* **Message:** The `domain.com` domain is not verified. Please, add and verify your domain.
* **Suggested action:** Make sure the domain in your API request's `from` field matches a domain you've verified in Resend. Update your API request to use your verified domain, or add and verify the domain you're trying to use. [Learn more about resolving this error](/docs/knowledge-base/403-error-domain-mismatch).

### `validation_error`

* **Status:** 403
* **Message:** The `example.com` domain has been registered already.
* **Suggested action:** Verify you are signed in to the correct Resend account and check whether a teammate already added the domain. If you still cannot access it, [contact support](https://resend.com/help). [Learn more about resolving this error](/docs/knowledge-base/domain-already-registered).

### `validation_error`

* **Status:** 403
* **Message:** You have reached the inboxes included in your plan. Enable pay-as-you-go for inboxes at [https://resend.com/settings/usage](https://resend.com/settings/usage) to add more.
* **Suggested action:** Every plan includes 3 inboxes. A team admin can enable pay-as-you-go for inboxes in your [usage settings](https://resend.com/settings/usage), after which each extra inbox costs \$1 per month.

### `validation_error`

* **Status:** 403
* **Message:** You have reached the inboxes included in your plan. Upgrade your Transactional plan to unlock pay-as-you-go for inboxes.
* **Suggested action:** Every plan includes 3 inboxes, and pay-as-you-go for inboxes needs a paid Transactional plan. [Upgrade your plan](https://resend.com/settings/billing), then enable pay-as-you-go for inboxes in your [usage settings](https://resend.com/settings/usage).

### `validation_error`

* **Status:** 403
* **Message:** You have reached the inboxes included in your plan. Pay-as-you-go for inboxes isn't available for your billing setup.
* **Suggested action:** Teams billed through Vercel or Stripe Projects cannot enable pay-as-you-go for inboxes. [Contact support](https://resend.com/help) if you need more than the 3 included inboxes.

### `validation_error`

* **Status:** 403
* **Message:** You have reached the inboxes included in your plan. Manage pay-as-you-go for inboxes at [https://resend.com/settings/usage](https://resend.com/settings/usage) to add more.
* **Suggested action:** Every plan includes 3 inboxes. Open your [usage settings](https://resend.com/settings/usage) to enable pay-as-you-go for inboxes, which needs a paid Transactional plan.

### `not_found`

* **Status:** 404
* **Message:** The requested endpoint does not exist.
* **Suggested action:** Change your request URL to match a valid API endpoint.

### `method_not_allowed`

* **Status:** 405
* **Message:** Method is not allowed for the requested path.
* **Suggested action:** Change your API endpoint to use a valid method.

### `concurrent_idempotent_requests`

* **Status:** 409
* **Message:** There is another request in progress with the same idempotency key.
* **Suggested action:** Try the request again later.

### `invalid_idempotent_request`

* **Status:** 409
* **Message:** This idempotency key has been used with this HTTP method and endpoint within the last 24 hours, but the request body was modified and doesn't match the original request.
* **Suggested action:** Change your idempotency key or payload.

### `resource_locked`

* **Status:** 409
* **Message:** Another request is already updating this resource.
* **Suggested action:** Retry the request after a short delay.

### `invalid_attachment`

* **Status:** 422
* **Message:** Attachment must have either a `content` or `path`.
* **Suggested action:** Attachments must either have a `content` (strings, Buffer, or Stream contents) or `path` to a remote resource (better for larger attachments).

### `invalid_parameter`

* **Status:** 422
* **Message:** The `parameter` must be a valid UUID.
* **Suggested action:** Check the value and make sure it's valid.

### `missing_required_field`

* **Status:** 422
* **Message:** The request body is missing one or more required fields.
* **Suggested action:** Check the error message to see the list of missing fields.

### `missing_required_parameter`

* **Status:** 422
* **Message:** The request is missing one or more required parameters.
* **Suggested action:** Check the error message to see the list of missing parameters.

### `daily_quota_exceeded`

* **Status:** 429
* **Message:** You have exceeded your daily email sending quota.
* **Suggested action:** [Upgrade your plan](https://resend.com/settings/billing) to remove the daily quota limit or wait for the quota to reset at midnight UTC. Both sent and received emails count towards this quota.

### `monthly_quota_exceeded`

* **Status:** 429
* **Message:** You have exceeded your monthly email sending quota.
* **Suggested action:** [Upgrade your plan](https://resend.com/settings/billing) to increase the monthly email quota. Both sent and received emails count towards this quota.

### `rate_limit_exceeded`

* **Status:** 429
* **Message:** Too many requests. Please limit the number of requests per second. Or [contact support](https://resend.com/contact) to increase rate limit.
* **Suggested action:** Read the [response headers](/docs/api-reference/introduction#rate-limit) and reduce the rate at which you request the API. This can be done by introducing a queue mechanism or reducing the number of concurrent requests per second. If you have specific requirements, [contact support](https://resend.com/contact) to request a rate increase.

### `application_error`

* **Status:** 500
* **Message:** An unexpected error occurred.
* **Suggested action:** Try the request again later. If the error does not resolve, check our [status page](https://resend-status.com) for service updates.

### `service_unavailable`

* **Status:** 503
* **Message:** API is temporarily unavailable
* **Suggested action:** Try the request again later. Check our [status page](https://resend-status.com) for service updates.


# Create Event
Source: https://resend.com/docs/api-reference/events/create-event

POST /events
Create a new event that can be used to trigger automations.

## Body Parameters

**name** `string` *required*

The name of the event. Used to match events to automation triggers.

> [!NOTE]
>
> The event name can be any string (e.g., `user.created`, `welcome`,
> `my-custom-event`). Dot notation is a recommended convention but is not
> required. If multiple enabled automations use the same event name, all of them
> will be triggered. Use unique event names if you want to target a specific
> automation.

> [!WARNING]
>
> Event names cannot start with the `resend:` prefix, which is reserved for system events.

**schema** `object`

An optional schema definition for the event payload. Must be an object with
flat key/type pairs. Supported types: `string`, `number`, `boolean`, `date`.

```ts Node.js theme={"theme":{"light":"github-light","dark":"vesper"}}
import { Resend } from 'resend';

const resend = new Resend('re_xxxxxxxxx');

const { data, error } = await resend.events.create({
  name: 'user.created',
  schema: {
    plan: 'string',
  },
});
```

```php PHP theme={"theme":{"light":"github-light","dark":"vesper"}}
$resend = Resend::client('re_xxxxxxxxx');

$resend->events->create([
  'name' => 'user.created',
  'schema' => ['plan' => 'string'],
]);
```

```python Python theme={"theme":{"light":"github-light","dark":"vesper"}}
import resend

resend.api_key = "re_xxxxxxxxx"

params: resend.Events.CreateParams = {
  "name": "user.created",
  "schema": {
    "plan": "string",
  },
}

resend.Events.create(params)
```

```ruby Ruby theme={"theme":{"light":"github-light","dark":"vesper"}}

  name: "user.created",

		},
	}
```

```go Go theme={"theme":{"light":"github-light","dark":"vesper"}}
}
```


# Retrieve Event
Source: https://resend.com/docs/api-reference/events/get-event

```ts Node.js theme={"theme":{"light":"github-light","dark":"vesper"}}
import { Resend } from 'resend';

```

```php PHP theme={"theme":{"light":"github-light","dark":"vesper"}}

$resend->events->get('user.created');
```

# List Events
Source: https://resend.com/docs/api-reference/events/list-events

GET /events
Retrieve a list of events.

## Query Parameters

**limit** `number`

Number of events to retrieve.
<ul><li>Default value: `20`</li>
<li>Maximum value: `100`</li>
<li>Minimum value: `1`</li></ul>

**after** `string`

The ID *after* which we'll retrieve more events (for pagination).
This ID will *not* be included in the returned list. Cannot be
used with the
`before` parameter.
**before** `string`

The ID *before* which we'll retrieve more events (for
pagination). This ID will *not* be included in the returned list.
Cannot be used with the `after` parameter.

> [!NOTE]
>
> You can only use either `after` or `before`
> parameter, not both. See our
> [pagination guide](/docs/api-reference/pagination) for more
> information.

```ts Node.js theme={"theme":{"light":"github-light","dark":"vesper"}}
import { Resend } from 'resend';

const resend = new Resend('re_xxxxxxxxx');

const { data, error } = await resend.events.list();
```


# Send Event
Source: https://resend.com/docs/api-reference/events/send-event

POST /events/send
Send a named event to trigger matching automations.

## Body Parameters

**event** `string` *required*

The name of the event to trigger. Must match the event name configured in an
automation trigger step.

Either `contact_id` or `email` must be provided, but not both.

The contact ID (UUID) to associate with this event. Exactly one of
`contact_id` or `email` must be provided.

**email** `string`

The email address to associate with this event. Exactly one of `contact_id` or
`email` must be provided. If no contact with this email exists in your
Audience, one will be created automatically when the automation runs.

**payload** `object`

An optional object containing custom data to pass to the automation. This data
can be used in template variables and conditions. If the event has a schema
defined, the payload values will be validated and coerced to match the schema
types.

```ts Node.js theme={"theme":{"light":"github-light","dark":"vesper"}}
import { Resend } from 'resend';

const resend = new Resend('re_xxxxxxxxx');

const { data, error } = await resend.events.send({
  event: 'user.created',
  contactId: '7f2e4a3b-dfbc-4e9a-8b2c-5f3a1d6e7c8b',
  // or: email: 'steve.wozniak@gmail.com',
  payload: {
    plan: 'pro',
  },
});
```

```php PHP theme={"theme":{"light":"github-light","dark":"vesper"}}
$resend = Resend::client('re_xxxxxxxxx');

// Trigger with a contact ID
$resend->events->send([
  'event' => 'user.created',
  'contact_id' => '7f2e4a3b-dfbc-4e9a-8b2c-5f3a1d6e7c8b',
  'payload' => ['plan' => 'pro'],
]);

// Trigger with an email address
$resend->events->send([
  'event' => 'user.created',
  'email' => 'steve.wozniak@gmail.com',
  'payload' => ['plan' => 'pro'],
]);
```

```python Python theme={"theme":{"light":"github-light","dark":"vesper"}}
import resend

resend.api_key = "re_xxxxxxxxx"

# Trigger with a contact ID
params: resend.Events.SendParams = {
  "event": "user.created",
  "contact_id": "7f2e4a3b-dfbc-4e9a-8b2c-5f3a1d6e7c8b",
  "payload": {
    "plan": "pro",
  },
}

resend.Events.send(params)

# Trigger with an email address
params: resend.Events.SendParams = {
  "event": "user.created",
  "email": "steve.wozniak@gmail.com",
  "payload": {
    "plan": "pro",
  },
}

resend.Events.send(params)
```

```ruby Ruby theme={"theme":{"light":"github-light","dark":"vesper"}}

  },
}

Resend::Events.send(params)

# Trigger with an email address

  },

```

```go Go theme={"theme":{"light":"github-light","dark":"vesper"}}
package main

import "github.com/resend/resend-go/v4"

func main() {
	client := resend.NewClient("re_xxxxxxxxx")

	// Trigger with a contact ID
	params := &resend.SendEventRequest{
		Event:     "user.created",
		ContactId: "7f2e4a3b-dfbc-4e9a-8b2c-5f3a1d6e7c8b",
		Payload: map[string]any{
			"plan": "pro",
		},
	}

	client.Events.Send(params)

	// Trigger with an email address
	params = &resend.SendEventRequest{
		Event: "user.created",
		Email: "steve.wozniak@gmail.com",
		Payload: map[string]any{
			"plan": "pro",
		},
	}

	client.Events.Send(params)
}
```

```rust Rust theme={"theme":{"light":"github-light","dark":"vesper"}}
use resend_rs::{
  json,
  types::{ContactIdOrEmail, SendEventOptions},
  Resend, Result,
};

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() -> Result<()> {
  let resend = Resend::new("re_xxxxxxxxx");

  let opts = SendEventOptions {
    event: "user.created".to_owned(),
    contact_id_or_email: ContactIdOrEmail::ContactId(
      "7f2e4a3b-dfbc-4e9a-8b2c-5f3a1d6e7c8b".to_owned(),
    ),
    // or: ContactIdOrEmail::Email("steve.wozniak@gmail.com".to_owned())
    payload: json!({
      "plan": "pro"
    }),
  };

  let _event = resend.events.send(opts).await?;

  Ok(())
}
```

```java Java theme={"theme":{"light":"github-light","dark":"vesper"}}

                .event("user.created")
                .contactId("7f2e4a3b-dfbc-4e9a-8b2c-5f3a1d6e7c8b") // or: .email("steve.wozniak@gmail.com")
                .addPayload("plan", "pro")
                .build();

        SendEventResponseSuccess data = resend.events().send(params);
    }
}
```

# Update Event
Source: https://resend.com/docs/api-reference/events/update-event

PATCH /events/:id
Update an existing event schema.

## Path Parameters

The event ID or name.

## Body Parameters

**schema** `object` *required*

The updated schema definition for the event payload. Must be an object with
flat key/type pairs, or `null` to clear the schema. Supported types: `string`,
`number`, `boolean`, `date`.

```ts Node.js theme={"theme":{"light":"github-light","dark":"vesper"}}
import { Resend } from 'resend';

const resend = new Resend('re_xxxxxxxxx');

const { data, error } = await resend.events.update('user.created', {
  schema: {
    plan: 'string',
    trial: 'boolean',
  },
});
```

```php PHP theme={"theme":{"light":"github-light","dark":"vesper"}}
$resend = Resend::client('re_xxxxxxxxx');

$resend->events->update('user.created', [
  'schema' => [
    'plan' => 'string',
    'trial' => 'boolean',
  ],
]);
```

```python Python theme={"theme":{"light":"github-light","dark":"vesper"}}
import resend

resend.api_key = "re_xxxxxxxxx"

params: resend.Events.UpdateParams = {
  "identifier": "user.created",
  "schema": {
    "plan": "string",
    "trial": "boolean",
  },
}

resend.Events.update(params)
```

```ruby Ruby theme={"theme":{"light":"github-light","dark":"vesper"}}
require "resend"

Resend.api_key = "re_xxxxxxxxx"

params = {
  identifier: "user.created",
  schema: {
    plan: "string",

```

```go Go theme={"theme":{"light":"github-light","dark":"vesper"}}
package main

import "github.com/resend/resend-go/v4"

func main() {
	client := resend.NewClient("re_xxxxxxxxx")

	params := &resend.UpdateEventRequest{
		Schema: map[string]string{
			"plan":  resend.EventSchemaTypeString,
			"trial": resend.EventSchemaTypeBoolean,
		},
	}

	client.Events.Update("user.created", params)
}
```

```rust Rust theme={"theme":{"light":"github-light","dark":"vesper"}}

  let resend = Resend::new("re_xxxxxxxxx");

  let opts = UpdateEventOptions {
    schema: json!({
      "plan": "string",
      "trial": "boolean",
    }),
  };

  let _event = resend.events.update("user.created", opts).await?;

  Ok(())
}
```

```java Java theme={"theme":{"light":"github-light","dark":"vesper"}}
import com.resend.Resend;

import com.resend.services.events.model.UpdateEventResponseSuccess;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws ResendException {
        Resend resend = new Resend("re_xxxxxxxxx");

        UpdateEventOptions params = UpdateEventOptions.builder()
                .identifier("user.created")
                .addSchema("plan", "string")
                .addSchema("trial", "boolean")
                .build();

        UpdateEventResponseSuccess data = resend.events().update(params);
    }
}
```

# Add Thread Labels
Source: https://resend.com/docs/api-reference/inboxes/add-thread-labels

POST /inboxes/:inbox_id/threads/:thread_id/labels
Apply one or more labels to a thread.

Labels already on the thread stay on it. If any label ID is not found, the
request returns a `404` and nothing changes. To replace the thread's labels
instead, use [Set Thread Labels](/docs/api-reference/inboxes/set-thread-labels).

## Path Parameters

The Inbox ID or the inbox email address, such as `support@example.com`.

The Thread ID.

## Body Parameters

**labels** `string[]` *required*

The IDs of the labels to apply. Between 1 and 10 IDs, each belonging to the
inbox.

## Response Fields

**object** `string`

Always `list`.

**data** `array`

Every label on the thread after the change.

**properties**

**id** `string`

The ID of the label.

**name** `string`

The name of the label.

**color** `string`

The color of the label as an uppercase `#RRGGBB` hex code, like
`#E93D82`.

```ts Node.js theme={"theme":{"light":"github-light","dark":"vesper"}}
import { Resend } from 'resend';

const resend = new Resend('re_xxxxxxxxx');

const { data, error } = await resend.inboxes.threads.labels.add({
  inboxId: 'b3e2b2b6-3f0e-4c8e-9ad3-2f43a1e2c7f1',
  threadId: '4d8e2a1c-9b3f-4c6d-8a21-3e5f7c9c0d12',
  labels: ['7f9c1d2e-4a6b-4c3d-8e15-9b0a7c6d5e34'],
});
```

```php PHP theme={"theme":{"light":"github-light","dark":"vesper"}}
$resend = Resend::client('re_xxxxxxxxx');

$resend->inboxes->threads->labels->add(
  'b3e2b2b6-3f0e-4c8e-9ad3-2f43a1e2c7f1',
  '4d8e2a1c-9b3f-4c6d-8a21-3e5f7c9c0d12',
  [
    'labels' => ['7f9c1d2e-4a6b-4c3d-8e15-9b0a7c6d5e34'],
  ]
);
```

# Create Draft
Source: https://resend.com/docs/api-reference/inboxes/create-draft

POST /inboxes/:inbox_id/drafts
Create a draft in an inbox, either to start a new thread or reply to an existing thread.

A draft lets you prepare a message before sending it.

Omit `thread_id` and `reply_to_email_id` to start a new thread. Pass both for a
reply draft.

An email can have only one unsent reply draft. A request for an email that
already has one returns a `200` with the existing Draft ID. It changes only the
`attachments` of that draft.

## Path Parameters

The Inbox ID or the inbox email address, such as `support@example.com`.

## Body Parameters

At least one of `to`, `cc`, `bcc`, `subject`, `text`, `html`, or `attachments`
must be non-empty. `to`, `cc`, and `bcc` combined cannot exceed 50 recipients.

**to** `string | string[] | null`

Recipients. For multiple addresses, send an array of strings. Each value can
include a friendly name, for example `Ada Lovelace <ada@example.org>`. On a
reply draft, when you omit `to` or send `null`, the draft gets the recipients
of a [reply](/docs/api-reference/inboxes/reply-thread-email). Send `[]` for no
recipients.

**cc** `string | string[] | null`

CC recipients.

**bcc** `string | string[] | null`

BCC recipients.

**subject** `string | null`

The subject. 1 to 2000 characters, with no line breaks.

**html** `string | null`

The HTML body.

**text** `string | null`

The plain-text body.

**attachments** `array | null`

Files to store on the draft, up to 25 MB in total. Drafts do not accept
`path` or `content_id`.

**properties**

**content** `buffer | string` *required*

Content of an attached file, passed as a buffer or Base64 string.

**filename** `string` *required*

Name of attached file.

Content type for the attachment. Must be a valid MIME type, such as
`application/pdf`.

The Thread ID to reply in. Must be sent with `reply_to_email_id`.

The Email ID to reply to, as returned by [List Thread
Emails](/docs/api-reference/inboxes/list-thread-emails) in `data[].id`. Must be
sent with `thread_id`.

## Headers

**Idempotency-Key** `string`

Add an idempotency key to prevent duplicated drafts.

* Should be **unique per API request**
* Idempotency keys expire after **24 hours**
* Have a maximum length of **256 characters**
* A retry with the same key returns the first successful response, with the
  `idempotent-replayed: true` header
* A failed request is not stored, so you can retry it with the same key
* Reusing the key with a different body, or while the first request is still
  running, returns a `409`

[Learn more](/docs/dashboard/emails/idempotency-keys)

## Response Fields

**object** `string`

Always `inbox_draft`.

**id** `string`

The ID of the draft.

```rust Rust theme={"theme":{"light":"github-light","dark":"vesper"}}
    .await?;

}
```

# Create Inbox
Source: https://resend.com/docs/api-reference/inboxes/create-inbox

POST /inboxes
Create an inbox to send, receive and organize email.

An inbox sends and receives email at an address on one of your domains, such as
`support@example.com`.

Without `forwarding`, the domain must have receiving enabled, with DKIM and SPF
verified and the inbound MX record verified or pending. With `forwarding` set to
`true`, the domain needs only DKIM and SPF verified. Otherwise, the request
returns a `422`. An address that is already in use
returns a `409`. A team at the inbox limit of its plan gets a `403`.

## Body Parameters

The inbox email address on one of your verified domains. The part before the
`@` can contain only letters, numbers, and `.`, `_`, `%`, and `-`, up to 64
characters. It cannot start or end with `.` or have two `.` in a row. To call
an inbox with a `%` in its address, use the Inbox ID in the path.

**name** `string`

Internal name for the inbox. Recipients do not see it. Max 64 characters.
Defaults to `email_address`.

The name recipients see when mail is sent from this inbox. Use a plain name,
without `:`, `<`, `>`, or line breaks. Max 78 characters. An email address in
the name must be on one of your verified domains.

**forwarding** `boolean` (default: false)

When `true`, Resend provisions a receiving address so you can receive mail
without adding an MX record. Read it from `receiving_address` with [Get
Inbox](/docs/api-reference/inboxes/get-inbox).

## Response Fields

**object** `string`

Always `inbox`.

**id** `string`

The ID of the inbox.

```ts Node.js theme={"theme":{"light":"github-light","dark":"vesper"}}
import { Resend } from 'resend';

const resend = new Resend('re_xxxxxxxxx');

const { data, error } = await resend.inboxes.create({
  emailAddress: 'support@example.com',
  name: 'Customer Support',
  fromName: 'Ada from Support',
});
```

# Create Label
Source: https://resend.com/docs/api-reference/inboxes/create-label

POST /inboxes/:inbox_id/labels
Create a label on an inbox.

A label is a named, colored tag that belongs to one inbox. An inbox can have at
most 100 labels. Label names are unique per inbox, compared without case. A
duplicate name returns a `422`.

## Path Parameters

The Inbox ID or the inbox email address, such as `support@example.com`.

## Body Parameters

**name** `string` *required*

The name of the label. Max 64 characters.

**color** `string`

The color of the label as a `#RRGGBB` hex code, like `#E93D82`. Defaults to a
random color.

## Response Fields

**object** `string`

Always `inbox_label`.

**id** `string`

The ID of the label.

# Delete Draft
Source: https://resend.com/docs/api-reference/inboxes/delete-draft

DELETE /inboxes/:inbox_id/drafts/:draft_id
Discard an unsent draft.

Discards an unsent draft. A draft that was already sent returns a `409`.

## Path Parameters

The Inbox ID or the inbox email address, such as `support@example.com`.

The Draft ID.

## Response Fields

**object** `string`

Always `inbox_draft`.

**id** `string`

The ID of the draft.

**deleted** `boolean`

Returns `true` when the draft is deleted.

# Delete Thread
Source: https://resend.com/docs/api-reference/inboxes/delete-thread

DELETE /inboxes/:inbox_id/threads/:thread_id
Move a thread to the trash folder.

Deleting a thread moves it to `trash` and schedules it for deletion in 30
days.

> [!NOTE]
>
> This is reversible. To restore a thread, [update
> it](/docs/api-reference/inboxes/update-thread) back to `inbox`, `archive`, or
> `spam`, which also clears the deletion deadline.

## Path Parameters

The Inbox ID or the inbox email address, such as `support@example.com`.

The Thread ID.

## Response Fields

**object** `string`

Always `inbox_thread`.

**id** `string`

The ID of the thread.

**deleted** `boolean`

Returns `true` when the thread is moved to `trash`, and `false` when the
thread was already there.

```ts Node.js theme={"theme":{"light":"github-light","dark":"vesper"}}
import { Resend } from 'resend';

const resend = new Resend('re_xxxxxxxxx');

const { data, error } = await resend.inboxes.threads.remove({
  inboxId: 'b3e2b2b6-3f0e-4c8e-9ad3-2f43a1e2c7f1',
  threadId: '4d8e2a1c-9b3f-4c6d-8a21-3e5f7c9c0d12',
});
```

```php PHP theme={"theme":{"light":"github-light","dark":"vesper"}}

  '4d8e2a1c-9b3f-4c6d-8a21-3e5f7c9c0d12'
);
```

# Forward Thread Email
Source: https://resend.com/docs/api-reference/inboxes/forward-thread-email

POST /inboxes/:inbox_id/threads/:thread_id/emails/:email_id/forward
Forward a message in an inbox thread to new recipients.

Forwards a message from the inbox address.

The attachments of the original message are sent with the forward, together
with any `attachments` you add. The request fails when they exceed 25 MB of
`content` in total. Files you add with `path` do not count toward it. An original
attachment that was sent from a URL (`path`) cannot be forwarded, and the
request returns a `422`. The whole email can be at most 40 MB.

The forward carries the same `In-Reply-To` and `References` headers as a
[reply](/docs/api-reference/inboxes/reply-thread-email) to the original message, so
mail clients may group it with the original conversation.

## Path Parameters

The Inbox ID or the inbox email address, such as `support@example.com`.

The Thread ID.

The Email ID of the message to forward, as returned by [List Thread
Emails](/docs/api-reference/inboxes/list-thread-emails) in `data[].id`.

## Body Parameters

**to** `string | string[]` *required*

Recipient email address. For multiple addresses, send as an array of strings.
Must name at least one address. `to`, `cc`, and `bcc` combined cannot exceed
50 recipients.

**cc** `string | string[] | null`

CC recipient email address.

**bcc** `string | string[] | null`

BCC recipient email address.

**html** `string`

An HTML note sent above the quoted original.

**text** `string`

A plain-text note sent above the quoted original.

**subject** `string`

The subject of the forward. 1 to 2000 characters, with no line breaks.
Defaults to the thread subject with a `Fwd:` prefix.

**attachments** `array | null`

Files to attach, as on [Send Email](/docs/api-reference/emails/send-email).

**properties**

**content** `buffer | string`

Content of an attached file, passed as a buffer or Base64 string.

**filename** `string`

Name of attached file.

**path** `string`

Path where the attachment file is hosted.

Content type for the attachment. When not set, it is derived from the
`filename`.

Content ID for embedding inline images with a `cid:` reference in the
`html`. [Learn about inline images](/docs/dashboard/emails/embed-inline-images).

**headers** `object | null`

Custom headers to add to the email. You cannot set `In-Reply-To`,
`References`, or `Reply-To`.

## Headers

**Idempotency-Key** `string`

Add an idempotency key to prevent duplicated emails.

* Should be **unique per API request**
* Idempotency keys expire after **24 hours**
* Have a maximum length of **256 characters**
* A retry with the same key returns the first successful response, with the
  `idempotent-replayed: true` header
* A failed request is not stored, so you can retry it with the same key
* Reusing the key with a different body, or while the first request is still
  running, returns a `409`

[Learn more](/docs/dashboard/emails/idempotency-keys)

## Response Fields

**id** `string`

The ID of the sent email. Use it with the [emails
endpoints](/docs/api-reference/emails/retrieve-email).

```ts Node.js theme={"theme":{"light":"github-light","dark":"vesper"}}
import { Resend } from 'resend';

const resend = new Resend('re_xxxxxxxxx');

const { data, error } = await resend.inboxes.threads.emails.forward({
  inboxId: 'b3e2b2b6-3f0e-4c8e-9ad3-2f43a1e2c7f1',
  threadId: '4d8e2a1c-9b3f-4c6d-8a21-3e5f7c9c0d12',
  emailId: '5b1a9f47-2c8d-4e6f-9a03-1d2e3f4a5b60',
  to: ['colleague@example.org'],
  cc: ['billing@example.com'],
  bcc: ['records@example.com'],
  text: 'Flagging this refund request for you.',
  attachments: [
    {
      path: 'https://resend.com/static/sample/invoice.pdf',
      filename: 'invoice.pdf',
    },
  ],
});
```

```php PHP theme={"theme":{"light":"github-light","dark":"vesper"}}
$resend = Resend::client('re_xxxxxxxxx');

$resend->inboxes->threads->emails->forward(
  'b3e2b2b6-3f0e-4c8e-9ad3-2f43a1e2c7f1',

  '5b1a9f47-2c8d-4e6f-9a03-1d2e3f4a5b60',
  [
    'to' => ['colleague@example.org'],
    'cc' => ['billing@example.com'],
    'bcc' => ['records@example.com'],
    'text' => 'Flagging this refund request for you.',
    'attachments' => [
      [
        'path' => 'https://resend.com/static/sample/invoice.pdf',
        'filename' => 'invoice.pdf',
      ],
    ],
  ]
);
```

```go Go theme={"theme":{"light":"github-light","dark":"vesper"}}
package main

import "github.com/resend/resend-go/v4"

func main() {
	client := resend.NewClient("re_xxxxxxxxx")

	params := &resend.ForwardInboxThreadEmailRequest{
		To:   []string{"colleague@example.org"},
		Cc:   []string{"billing@example.com"},
		Bcc:  []string{"records@example.com"},
		Text: "Flagging this refund request for you.",
		Attachments: []*resend.Attachment{
			{
				Path:     "https://resend.com/static/sample/invoice.pdf",
				Filename: "invoice.pdf",
			},
		},
	}

	client.Inboxes.Threads.Emails.Forward(
		"b3e2b2b6-3f0e-4c8e-9ad3-2f43a1e2c7f1",
		"4d8e2a1c-9b3f-4c6d-8a21-3e5f7c9c0d12",
		"5b1a9f47-2c8d-4e6f-9a03-1d2e3f4a5b60",
		params,
	)
```

```rust Rust theme={"theme":{"light":"github-light","dark":"vesper"}}
use resend_rs::{
  types::{CreateAttachment, ForwardInboxThreadEmailOptions},
  Resend, Result,
};

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() -> Result<()> {
  let resend = Resend::new("re_xxxxxxxxx");

  let opts = ForwardInboxThreadEmailOptions::new(["colleague@example.org"])
    .with_cc(["billing@example.com"])
    .with_bcc(["records@example.com"])
    .with_text("Flagging this refund request for you.")
    .with_attachment(
      CreateAttachment::from_path("https://resend.com/static/sample/invoice.pdf")
        .with_filename("invoice.pdf"),
    );

  let _forward = resend
    .inboxes
    .forward_thread_email(
      "b3e2b2b6-3f0e-4c8e-9ad3-2f43a1e2c7f1",
      "4d8e2a1c-9b3f-4c6d-8a21-3e5f7c9c0d12",
      "5b1a9f47-2c8d-4e6f-9a03-1d2e3f4a5b60",
      opts,
    )
    .await?;

  Ok(())
}
```

```csharp .NET theme={"theme":{"light":"github-light","dark":"vesper"}}

    new Guid( "5b1a9f47-2c8d-4e6f-9a03-1d2e3f4a5b60" ),
    new InboxThreadEmailForwardData()
    {
        To = "colleague@example.org",
        Cc = "billing@example.com",
        Bcc = "records@example.com",
        TextBody = "Flagging this refund request for you.",
        Attachments =
        [
            new EmailAttachment()
            {
                Filename = "invoice.pdf",
                Path = "https://resend.com/static/sample/invoice.pdf",
            },
        ],
    }
);
Console.WriteLine( "Email Id={0}", resp.Content );
```

# Retrieve Agent Settings
Source: https://resend.com/docs/api-reference/inboxes/get-agent

GET /inboxes/:inbox_id/agent
Retrieve the agent settings for an inbox.

## Path Parameters

The Inbox ID or the inbox email address, such as `support@example.com`.

## Response Fields

**object** `string`

Always `inbox_agent`.

**instructions** `string | null`

Instructions the agent follows when handling the inbox's threads. `null` when
no instructions are set.

**tone** `'concise_professional' | 'concise_casual' | 'expanded_professional' | 'expanded_casual' | null`

Tone the agent writes in. `null` when no tone is set.

* `concise_professional`: Brief responses in a professional tone.
* `concise_casual`: Brief responses in a casual tone.
* `expanded_professional`: Detailed responses in a professional tone.
* `expanded_casual`: Detailed responses in a casual tone.

**actions** `string[]`

Actions the agent is allowed to take.

* `draft_reply`: Draft a reply.
* `forward_thread`: Forward a thread.
* `add_labels`: Add labels to a thread.
* `assign_thread`: Assign a thread.
* `mark_as_spam`: Mark a thread as spam.
* `archive`: Archive a thread.
* `move_to_trash`: Move a thread to the trash.

```ts Node.js theme={"theme":{"light":"github-light","dark":"vesper"}}
import { Resend } from 'resend';

const resend = new Resend('re_xxxxxxxxx');

const { data, error } = await resend.inboxes.agent.get({
  inboxId: 'b3e2b2b6-3f0e-4c8e-9ad3-2f43a1e2c7f1',
});
```

```php PHP theme={"theme":{"light":"github-light","dark":"vesper"}}
$resend = Resend::client('re_xxxxxxxxx');

$resend->inboxes->agent->get('b3e2b2b6-3f0e-4c8e-9ad3-2f43a1e2c7f1');
```

# Retrieve Draft
Source: https://resend.com/docs/api-reference/inboxes/get-draft

GET /inboxes/:inbox_id/drafts/:draft_id
Retrieve a single draft by its ID.

## Path Parameters

The Inbox ID or the inbox email address, such as `support@example.com`.

The Draft ID.

## Response Fields

**object** `string`

Always `inbox_draft`.

**id** `string`

The ID of the draft.

**type** `string`

`reply` when the draft replies to an email in an existing thread. `standalone`
when the draft starts a new thread.

**to** `string[] | null`

Recipients. `null` or empty when no recipients are set.

**cc** `string[]`

CC recipients.

**bcc** `string[]`

BCC recipients.

**subject** `string | null`

The subject.

**html** `string | null`

The HTML body.

**text** `string | null`

The plain-text body.

**thread\_id** `string | null`

The Thread ID when this draft is a reply. `null` otherwise.

**reply\_to\_email\_id** `string | null`

The Email ID being replied to. `null` otherwise.

**email\_id** `string | null`

The ID of the outbound email queued when the draft was sent. `null` until the
draft is sent.

**created\_at** `string`

ISO 8601 timestamp when the draft was created.

**updated\_at** `string`

ISO 8601 timestamp when the draft was last saved.

**attachments** `array`

The files saved on the draft.

**properties**

**id** `string`

The ID of the attachment.

**filename** `string`

The filename of the attachment.

**content\_type** `string`

The MIME type of the attachment, such as `application/pdf`.

**size** `number`

The size of the attachment in bytes.

```ts Node.js theme={"theme":{"light":"github-light","dark":"vesper"}}

  draftId: 'c3a1e8b4-2d5f-4a7c-9e10-6b8d7f5a4c32',
});
```

# Retrieve Inbox
Source: https://resend.com/docs/api-reference/inboxes/get-inbox

GET /inboxes/:inbox_id
Retrieve a single inbox by its ID or email address.

## Path Parameters

The Inbox ID or the inbox email address, such as `support@example.com`.

## Response Fields

**object** `string`

Always `inbox`.

**id** `string`

The ID of the inbox.

**name** `string`

Internal name for the inbox. Recipients do not see it.

**email\_address** `string`

The address of the inbox.

**domain\_id** `string`

The ID of the domain that owns the address.

**receiving\_address** `string | null`

The address to forward mail to when forwarding is enabled. `null` otherwise.

**from\_name** `string | null`

The name recipients see when mail is sent from this inbox. `null` when not
set.

**unread** `number`

The number of unread threads in the Inbox folder.

**drafts** `number`

The number of unsent drafts.

**last\_received** `string | null`

ISO 8601 timestamp of the newest received email in the Inbox folder. `null`
when the folder has no received email.

**created\_at** `string`

ISO 8601 timestamp when the inbox was created.

**updated\_at** `string`

ISO 8601 timestamp when the inbox was updated.

```ts Node.js theme={"theme":{"light":"github-light","dark":"vesper"}}

);
```

# Retrieve Thread
Source: https://resend.com/docs/api-reference/inboxes/get-thread

GET /inboxes/:inbox_id/threads/:thread_id
Retrieve a thread summary.

The response is the thread summary. Messages are listed separately with [List
Thread Emails](/docs/api-reference/inboxes/list-thread-emails).

## Path Parameters

The Inbox ID or the inbox email address, such as `support@example.com`.

The Thread ID.

## Response Fields

**object** `string`

Always `inbox_thread`.

**id** `string`

The ID of the thread.

**subject** `string | null`

The subject of the thread.

**folder** `string`

The folder the thread lives in. Every thread sits in exactly one folder within
its inbox. You can move a thread to `inbox`, `archive`, `spam`, or `trash`.
`sent` is assigned automatically.

* `inbox`: The default. The thread holds at least one received message.
* `archive`: The thread was archived.
* `spam`: The thread was marked as spam.
* `trash`: The thread is scheduled for deletion in 30 days.
* `sent`: Threads whose messages are all outbound.

**labels** `array`

The labels attached to the thread.

**properties**

**id** `string`

The ID of the label.

**name** `string`

The name of the label.

**color** `string`

The color of the label as an uppercase `#RRGGBB` hex code.

**read** `boolean`

True only when every message in the thread is read.

```ts Node.js theme={"theme":{"light":"github-light","dark":"vesper"}}

  threadId: '4d8e2a1c-9b3f-4c6d-8a21-3e5f7c9c0d12',
});
```

# Retrieve Thread Email
Source: https://resend.com/docs/api-reference/inboxes/get-thread-email

GET /inboxes/:inbox_id/threads/:thread_id/emails/:email_id
Retrieve a single message from a thread.

Returns one message of a thread. Each item from [List Thread
Emails](/docs/api-reference/inboxes/list-thread-emails) has this shape.

## Path Parameters

The Inbox ID or the inbox email address, such as `support@example.com`.

The Thread ID.

The Email ID, as returned by [List Thread
Emails](/docs/api-reference/inboxes/list-thread-emails) in `data[].id`.

## Response Fields

**id** `string`

The ID of the message.

**direction** `string`

Whether the message was received by the inbox or sent from it. One of
`inbound` or `outbound`. A message the inbox sent to itself is `inbound`, so a
reply to it goes to its sender.

**from** `string`

Sender email address. Includes the display name when the sender has one, in
the format `Name <sender@domain.com>`.

**to** `string[]`

The recipients of the message. For a received message, these are the addresses
it was delivered to, not the full `To` header.

**cc** `string[]`

The CC recipients of the message.

**bcc** `string[]`

The BCC recipients of the message. Always empty for a received message.

**reply\_to** `string[]`

The Reply-To addresses.

**subject** `string | null`

The subject of the message.

**message\_id** `string | null`

The Message-ID header of the message.

**html** `string | null`

The HTML body.

**text** `string | null`

The plain-text body.

**attachments** `array`

The attachments on the message.

**properties**

**id** `string`

The ID of the attachment.

**filename** `string | null`

The filename of the attachment.

**size** `number | null`

The size of the attachment in bytes.

**read** `boolean`

Whether the message has been read.

**received\_at** `string`

ISO 8601 timestamp when the inbox received the message, or when the inbox sent
it.

```ts Node.js theme={"theme":{"light":"github-light","dark":"vesper"}}
import { Resend } from 'resend';

const resend = new Resend('re_xxxxxxxxx');

const { data, error } = await resend.inboxes.threads.emails.get({
  inboxId: 'b3e2b2b6-3f0e-4c8e-9ad3-2f43a1e2c7f1',
  threadId: '4d8e2a1c-9b3f-4c6d-8a21-3e5f7c9c0d12',
  emailId: '5b1a9f47-2c8d-4e6f-9a03-1d2e3f4a5b60',
});
```

```php PHP theme={"theme":{"light":"github-light","dark":"vesper"}}
$resend = Resend::client('re_xxxxxxxxx');

$resend->inboxes->threads->emails->get(
  'b3e2b2b6-3f0e-4c8e-9ad3-2f43a1e2c7f1',
  '4d8e2a1c-9b3f-4c6d-8a21-3e5f7c9c0d12',
  '5b1a9f47-2c8d-4e6f-9a03-1d2e3f4a5b60'
);
```

```python Python theme={"theme":{"light":"github-light","dark":"vesper"}}

    inbox_id="b3e2b2b6-3f0e-4c8e-9ad3-2f43a1e2c7f1",
    thread_id="4d8e2a1c-9b3f-4c6d-8a21-3e5f7c9c0d12",
    email_id="5b1a9f47-2c8d-4e6f-9a03-1d2e3f4a5b60",
)
```

# List Drafts
Source: https://resend.com/docs/api-reference/inboxes/list-drafts

GET /inboxes/:inbox_id/drafts
Retrieve the unsent drafts in an inbox.

Returns the unsent drafts in the inbox, most recently updated first.

## Path Parameters

The Inbox ID or the inbox email address, such as `support@example.com`.

## Query Parameters

**limit** `number`

Number of drafts to return. Default is `20`, maximum is `100`, minimum is `1`.

**after** `string`

The ID of the last draft on the current page. Returns the next, older page.

**before** `string`

The ID of the first draft on the current page. Returns the previous, newer
page. Cannot be combined with `after`.

## Response Fields

**object** `string`

Always `list`.

**has\_more** `boolean`

Whether more drafts exist beyond this page. Pass the last draft's `id` as
`after` to continue.

**data** `array`

The drafts on this page.

**properties**

**id** `string`

The ID of the draft.

**type** `string`

`reply` when the draft replies to an email in an existing thread.
`standalone` when the draft starts a new thread.

**to** `string[] | null`

Recipients. `null` or empty when no recipients are set.

**cc** `string[]`

CC recipients.

**bcc** `string[]`

BCC recipients.

**subject** `string | null`

The subject.

**snippet** `string | null`

A short preview of the body.

**thread\_id** `string | null`

The Thread ID when this draft is a reply. `null` otherwise.

**reply\_to\_email\_id** `string | null`

The Email ID being replied to. `null` otherwise.

**updated\_at** `string`

ISO 8601 timestamp when the draft was last saved.

**attachments** `array`

The files saved on the draft.

**properties**

**id** `string`

The ID of the attachment.

**filename** `string`

The filename of the attachment.

**content\_type** `string`

The MIME type of the attachment, such as `application/pdf`.

**size** `number`

The size of the attachment in bytes.

```ts Node.js theme={"theme":{"light":"github-light","dark":"vesper"}}
import { Resend } from 'resend';

const resend = new Resend('re_xxxxxxxxx');

  inboxId: 'b3e2b2b6-3f0e-4c8e-9ad3-2f43a1e2c7f1',
});
```


# List Inboxes
Source: https://resend.com/docs/api-reference/inboxes/list-inboxes

GET /inboxes
Retrieve a list of inboxes for the team.

Inboxes are returned newest first. Results are paginated with cursors. See
[Pagination](/docs/api-reference/pagination) for how `after` and `before` work. The
cursors take an inbox ID. A value that is not a UUID returns a `422`, and an
unknown ID returns a `404`.

The list items carry fewer fields than a single inbox. [Retrieve an
inbox](/docs/api-reference/inboxes/get-inbox) to get all its fields.

## Query Parameters

**limit** `number`

Number of inboxes to retrieve.
<ul><li>Default value: `20`</li>
<li>Maximum value: `100`</li>
<li>Minimum value: `1`</li></ul>

**after** `string`

The ID *after* which we'll retrieve more inboxes (for pagination).
This ID will *not* be included in the returned list. Cannot be
used with the
`before` parameter.
**before** `string`

The ID *before* which we'll retrieve more inboxes (for
pagination). This ID will *not* be included in the returned list.
Cannot be used with the `after` parameter.

> [!NOTE]
>
> You can only use either `after` or `before`
> parameter, not both. See our
> [pagination guide](/docs/api-reference/pagination) for more
> information.

## Response Fields

**object** `string`

Always `list`.

**has\_more** `boolean`

Whether more inboxes exist beyond this page.

**data** `array`

The inboxes on this page.

**properties**

**id** `string`

The ID of the inbox.

**name** `string | null`

Internal name for the inbox. Recipients do not see it.

**email\_address** `string`

The address of the inbox.

**from\_name** `string | null`

The name recipients see when mail is sent from this inbox. `null` when
not set.

**unread** `number`

The number of unread threads in the Inbox folder.

**last\_received** `string | null`

ISO 8601 timestamp of the newest received email in the Inbox folder.
`null` when the folder has no received email.

**created\_at** `string`

ISO 8601 timestamp when the inbox was created.

**updated\_at** `string`

ISO 8601 timestamp when the inbox was updated.

```ts Node.js theme={"theme":{"light":"github-light","dark":"vesper"}}

```


# List Labels
Source: https://resend.com/docs/api-reference/inboxes/list-labels

GET /inboxes/:inbox_id/labels
Retrieve the labels on an inbox.

## Path Parameters

The Inbox ID or the inbox email address, such as `support@example.com`.

## Response Fields

**object** `string`

Always `list`.

**data** `array`

The labels on the inbox, oldest first.

**properties**

**id** `string`

The ID of the label.

**name** `string`

The name of the label.

**color** `string`

The color of the label as an uppercase `#RRGGBB` hex code, like
`#E93D82`.

**created\_at** `string`

ISO 8601 timestamp when the label was created.

```ts Node.js theme={"theme":{"light":"github-light","dark":"vesper"}}
import { Resend } from 'resend';

const { data, error } = await resend.inboxes.labels.list({
  inboxId: 'b3e2b2b6-3f0e-4c8e-9ad3-2f43a1e2c7f1',
});
```

# List Thread Emails
Source: https://resend.com/docs/api-reference/inboxes/list-thread-emails

GET /inboxes/:inbox_id/threads/:thread_id/emails
Retrieve the messages in a thread.

Messages are returned oldest first. Each item has the same shape as [Retrieve
Thread Email](/docs/api-reference/inboxes/get-thread-email).

## Path Parameters

The Inbox ID or the inbox email address, such as `support@example.com`.

The Thread ID.

## Query Parameters

**limit** `number`

Number of messages to return. Default is `20`, maximum is `100`, minimum is
`1`.

**after** `string`

The ID of the last message on the current page. Returns the next, newer page.

**before** `string`

The ID of the first message on the current page. Returns the previous, older
page. Cannot be combined with `after`.

## Response Fields

**object** `string`

Always `list`.

**has\_more** `boolean`

Whether more messages exist beyond this page. Pass the last message's `id` as
`after` to continue.

**data** `array`

The messages on this page.

**properties**

**id** `string`

The ID of the message.

**direction** `string`

Whether the message was received by the inbox or sent from it. One of
`inbound` or `outbound`. A message the inbox sent to itself is `inbound`, so
a reply to it goes to its sender.

**from** `string`

Sender email address. Includes the display name when the sender has one, in
the format `Name <sender@domain.com>`.

**to** `string[]`

The recipients of the message. For a received message, these are the
addresses it was delivered to, not the full `To` header.

**cc** `string[]`

The CC recipients of the message.

**bcc** `string[]`

The BCC recipients of the message. Always empty for a received message.

**reply\_to** `string[]`

The Reply-To addresses.

**subject** `string | null`

The subject of the message.

**message\_id** `string | null`

The Message-ID header of the message.

**html** `string | null`

The HTML body.

**text** `string | null`

The plain-text body.

**attachments** `array`

The attachments on the message.

**properties**

**id** `string`

The ID of the attachment.

**filename** `string | null`

The filename of the attachment.

**size** `number | null`

The size of the attachment in bytes.

**read** `boolean`

Whether the message has been read.

**received\_at** `string`

ISO 8601 timestamp when the inbox received the message, or when the inbox
sent it.

```ts Node.js theme={"theme":{"light":"github-light","dark":"vesper"}}
  threadId: '4d8e2a1c-9b3f-4c6d-8a21-3e5f7c9c0d12',
});
```

# List Threads
Source: https://resend.com/docs/api-reference/inboxes/list-threads

GET /inboxes/:inbox_id/threads
Retrieve the threads in an inbox, filtered by folder, label, and read status.

A thread is a conversation within an inbox, made up of one or more messages.

## Path Parameters

The Inbox ID or the inbox email address, such as `support@example.com`.

## Query Parameters

**folders** `string`

Comma-separated folders to list. Defaults to `inbox`, or to
`inbox,archive,sent` when `labels` is set.

* `inbox`: The default. The thread holds at least one received message.
* `archive`: The thread was archived.
* `spam`: The thread was marked as spam.
* `trash`: The thread is scheduled for deletion in 30 days.
* `sent`: Threads whose messages are all outbound.

**labels** `string`

Comma-separated label IDs. Returns threads with any of these labels. Up to
`50` IDs.

**read** `boolean`

`true` returns threads where every email is read. `false` returns threads with
at least one unread email.

**limit** `number`

Number of threads to return. Default is `20`, maximum is `100`, minimum is
`1`.

**after** `string`

The ID of the last thread on the current page. Returns the next, older page.
Must be a thread ID. To filter by date, use [Search
Threads](/docs/api-reference/inboxes/search-threads) with `start_date`.

**before** `string`

The ID of the first thread on the current page. Returns the previous, newer
page. Cannot be combined with `after`. Must be a thread ID. To filter by date,
use [Search Threads](/docs/api-reference/inboxes/search-threads) with `end_date`.

To find threads by text, sender, recipient, attachment, or date, use [Search
Threads](/docs/api-reference/inboxes/search-threads).

## Response Fields

**object** `string`

Always `list`.

**has\_more** `boolean`

Whether more threads exist beyond this page. Pass the last thread's `id` as
`after` to continue.

**data** `array`

The matching threads, most recently active first.

**properties**

**id** `string`

The ID of the thread.

**subject** `string | null`

The subject of the thread.

**from** `string | null`

Sender email address. Can include the display name.

**to** `string[]`

The recipients of the most recent message. For a received email, these
are the addresses it was delivered to, not the full `To` header.

**cc** `string[]`

The CC recipients of the most recent message.

**bcc** `string[]`

The BCC recipients of the most recent message. Always empty for a
received email.

**labels** `array`

The labels attached to the thread.

**properties**

**id** `string`

The ID of the label.

**name** `string`

The name of the label.

**color** `string`

The color of the label as an uppercase `#RRGGBB` hex code.

**email\_count** `number`

The number of emails in the thread.

**has\_attachment** `boolean`

Whether the most recent message in the thread has an attachment.

**has\_draft** `boolean`

Whether the thread has an unsent draft.

**read** `boolean`

True only when every message in the thread is read.

**received\_at** `string`

ISO 8601 timestamp when the thread was last active.

**folder** `string`

The folder the thread lives in. Every thread sits in exactly one folder
within its inbox. You can move a thread to `inbox`, `archive`, `spam`, or
`trash`. `sent` is assigned automatically.

* `inbox`: The default. The thread holds at least one received message.
* `archive`: The thread was archived.
* `spam`: The thread was marked as spam.
* `trash`: The thread is scheduled for deletion in 30 days.
* `sent`: Threads whose messages are all outbound.

# Remove Thread Label
Source: https://resend.com/docs/api-reference/inboxes/remove-thread-label

DELETE /inboxes/:inbox_id/threads/:thread_id/labels/:label_id
Take one label off a thread.

The label itself is kept, and stays on every other thread that carries it. To
delete the label everywhere, use
[Delete Label](/docs/api-reference/inboxes/delete-label).

## Path Parameters

The Inbox ID or the inbox email address, such as `support@example.com`.

The Thread ID.

The Label ID.

## Response Fields

**object** `string`

Always `list`.

**data** `array`

Every label on the thread after the change.

**properties**

**id** `string`

The ID of the label.

**name** `string`

The name of the label.

**color** `string`

The color of the label as an uppercase `#RRGGBB` hex code, like
`#E93D82`.

```ts Node.js theme={"theme":{"light":"github-light","dark":"vesper"}}

  threadId: '4d8e2a1c-9b3f-4c6d-8a21-3e5f7c9c0d12',
  labelId: '7f9c1d2e-4a6b-4c3d-8e15-9b0a7c6d5e34',
```
